card.name: Words just before God or Creator
card.fires_on: Small linking words (One, the, of, a, not, be) right before an expected word for God, the Creator, or the eternal, in religious or philosophical prose.

modes.label: Before God
modes.description: A number or article right before the word God in statements of belief.
modes.example: Based on the belief in<< One>> God, the Sikh religion recognizes the equality

modes.label: Before Creator
modes.description: An article before Creator or a higher being.
modes.example: our universe is actually an open system to<< a>> Creator that transcends everything that is physical

modes.label: Eternal qualities
modes.description: Words leading into eternal, infinite or immutable descriptions of the divine.
modes.example: God would have a beginning and be finite,<< not>> infinite.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like eternal, everlasting and transcendent.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the text names God or something eternal.
